::: {#perfil}

BSc student in Data Science and AI at FGV EMAp, scholarship holder of the CDMC Talent Selection program. He conducts undergraduate research (PIBIC/CNPq) at the GAIA Lab, advised by Prof. Dario Oliveira, applying deep learning and computer vision to satellite imagery. He also develops AI and RAG for the Mosqlimate project and served as a teaching assistant at EMAp.

## Education

- BSc student in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.
- Technical degree in Informatics, IFMS.

## Interests

Deep learning, computer vision, geospatial modeling, and AI engineering.
